import json
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from solution import decode_packet, encode_packet


class PacketCodecTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.packet = {"sender": "Alice", "topic": "status", "message": "ready & <go>"}

    def test_json_round_trip_compact_order_and_media_parameters(self):
        encoded = encode_packet(self.packet, "  Application/Vnd.Packet+Json; charset=utf-8  ")
        self.assertEqual(encoded,
                         '{"sender":"Alice","topic":"status","message":"ready & <go>"}')
        self.assertEqual(decode_packet(encoded.encode("utf-8"),
                                       "APPLICATION/VND.PACKET+JSON;version=1"), self.packet)

    def test_xml_round_trip_structure_and_order(self):
        encoded = encode_packet(self.packet, " application/vnd.packet+xml ; charset=UTF-8")
        root = ET.fromstring(encoded)
        self.assertEqual(root.tag, "packet")
        self.assertEqual([child.tag for child in root], ["sender", "topic", "message"])
        self.assertEqual([child.text for child in root], ["Alice", "status", "ready & <go>"])
        self.assertEqual(decode_packet(encoded, "application/vnd.packet+xml"), self.packet)

    def test_empty_string_fields_are_supported(self):
        packet = {"sender": "", "topic": "", "message": ""}
        self.assertEqual(decode_packet(encode_packet(packet, "application/vnd.packet+xml"),
                                       "application/vnd.packet+xml"), packet)
        self.assertEqual(decode_packet(encode_packet(packet, "application/vnd.packet+json"),
                                       "application/vnd.packet+json"), packet)

    def test_input_dictionary_is_not_mutated(self):
        packet = dict(self.packet)
        snapshot = dict(packet)
        encode_packet(packet, "application/vnd.packet+json")
        self.assertEqual(packet, snapshot)

    def test_rejects_invalid_packet_dictionaries(self):
        invalid = [
            None, [],
            {"sender": "a", "topic": "b"},
            {"sender": "a", "topic": "b", "message": "c", "extra": "d"},
            {"sender": "a", "topic": "b", "message": 3},
        ]
        for data in invalid:
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    encode_packet(data, "application/vnd.packet+json")

    def test_rejects_empty_malformed_and_non_utf8_bodies(self):
        for body in ("", " \r\n ", b""):
            with self.subTest(body=body):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_packet(body, "application/vnd.packet+json")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_packet("{bad", "application/vnd.packet+json")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_packet(b"\xff", "application/vnd.packet+json")
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
            decode_packet(123, "application/vnd.packet+json")
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
            decode_packet("[]", "application/vnd.packet+json")

    def test_rejects_invalid_xml_structure(self):
        invalid = [
            "<other><sender>a</sender><topic>b</topic><message>c</message></other>",
            "<packet><sender>a</sender><topic>b</topic></packet>",
            "<packet><sender>a</sender><topic>b</topic><message>c</message><x/></packet>",
            "<packet><topic>b</topic><sender>a</sender><message>c</message></packet>",
            "<packet><sender>a</sender><sender>b</sender><message>c</message></packet>",
            "<packet><sender><nested/></sender><topic>b</topic><message>c</message></packet>",
            "<packet>",
        ]
        for body in invalid:
            with self.subTest(body=body):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    decode_packet(body, "application/vnd.packet+xml")

    def test_media_type_selection_and_rejection(self):
        for media_type in ("text/json", "application/vnd.packet+jsonish", "", " ;charset=utf-8"):
            with self.subTest(media_type=media_type):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    encode_packet(self.packet, media_type)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_packet(self.packet, None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_packet("{}", "text/json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
